// Assessment-only synthetic response collector. Never starts a host or reads app data.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"

	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/apps/gallery"
)

type response struct {
	Path   string              `json:"path"`
	Status int                 `json:"status"`
	Header map[string][]string `json:"header"`
	Body   string              `json:"body"`
}

type lane struct {
	Name          string            `json:"name"`
	Theme         string            `json:"theme"`
	Width         int               `json:"width"`
	Height        int               `json:"height"`
	Period        string            `json:"period"`
	Compare       string            `json:"compare"`
	State         string            `json:"state"`
	Paths         map[string]string `json:"paths"`
}

type packet struct {
	Schema    string     `json:"schema"`
	Lanes     []lane     `json:"lanes"`
	Responses []response `json:"responses"`
}

func query(period, compare, category, state, theme string) string {
	return "?" + url.Values{
		"period":   {period},
		"compare":  {compare},
		"category": {category},
		"state":    {state},
		"theme":    {theme},
	}.Encode()
}

func collect(h http.Handler, path string) response {
	r := httptest.NewRecorder()
	h.ServeHTTP(r, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "http://127.0.0.1"+path, nil))
	return response{Path: path, Status: r.Code, Header: map[string][]string(r.Header()), Body: r.Body.String()}
}

func main() {
	// Keep the two lanes intentionally different: one exercises a paired complete
	// report at a wide viewport, the other an unpaired partial report at a narrow one.
	configs := []lane{
		{Name: "wide-light", Theme: "light", Width: 1440, Height: 1000, Period: "2026-09", Compare: "previous", State: "complete"},
		{Name: "narrow-dark", Theme: "dark", Width: 390, Height: 844, Period: "2026-08", Compare: "none", State: "partial"},
	}
	// Importing the Gallery here (rather than running a server) keeps the fixture
	// bound to the exact in-process handler and its exact response bytes.
	responses := make([]response, 0, 1+len(configs)*8)
	galleryHandler := gallery.New()
	for i := range configs {
		c := &configs[i]
		empty := query(c.Period, c.Compare, "empty", c.State, c.Theme)
		recovered := query(c.Period, c.Compare, "all", c.State, c.Theme)
		recipeEmpty := query(c.Period, "none", "empty", c.State, c.Theme)
		recipeRecovered := query(c.Period, "none", "all", c.State, c.Theme)
		c.Paths = map[string]string{
			"emptyOverview":       "/analytics" + empty,
			"emptyExport":         "/analytics/export.csv" + empty,
			"emptyDetail":         "/analytics/gateway-api" + empty,
			"recoveredOverview":   "/analytics" + recovered,
			"emptyRecipe":         "/analytics/recipe" + recipeEmpty,
			"recoveredRecipe":     "/analytics/recipe" + recipeRecovered,
			"contextCSV":          "/analytics/recipe/export.csv" + recipeEmpty,
			"headerOnlyTableCSV":  "/analytics/recipe/table.csv" + recipeEmpty,
		}
		for _, key := range []string{"emptyOverview", "emptyExport", "emptyDetail", "recoveredOverview", "emptyRecipe", "recoveredRecipe", "contextCSV", "headerOnlyTableCSV"} {
			responses = append(responses, collect(galleryHandler, c.Paths[key]))
		}
	}
	responses = append(responses, collect(galleryHandler, "/static/app.css"))
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(packet{
		Schema: "appkit-gallery-analytics-empty-selection-v1", Lanes: configs, Responses: responses,
	}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
